prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Einsteinium (아인슈타이늄) itself — the sovereign of the Einsteinium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a youthful face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a cool, aloof beauty; porcelain-pale skin; heart-shaped face; almond-shaped eyes of natural size; luminous Cherenkov-blue eyes; thin straight brows; slim, delicate nose with a refined bridge; slender lips of natural width.
Body and hair: lean and long-legged, with a natural neck length build; an angular chin-length bob with one long side lock; soft ash-white hair dusted with tiny specks glowing soft blue, like luminous falling ash.
Expression: precise and unreadable, eyes directly attentive.
Her element, carried in her design: einsteinium: a soft silvery synthetic metal first found in the fallout of the first hydrogen-bomb test in late 1952 on a Pacific coral atoll, sifted from filter papers flown through the towering cloud and from scraps of the atoll's coral, born when uranium swallowed fifteen neutrons in a single instant; the find was kept secret for years, and she was named for the most famous physicist of the century, the genius of relativity; her best-known form glows a soft blue by its own radioactivity and is so fierce that it slowly shatters its own crystal structure, and only the tiniest amounts of her have ever been gathered.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Pale ash-white and lagoon-turquoise armor with one long segmented mechanical tail reaching from the back of her waist, fine filter-wing vanes along its segments, tipped with a small glowing blue crystal that keeps cracking and re-forming, a soft blue self-glowing core at the chest, pale coral-pink accents; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: light body armor with several small shield and drone units floating symmetrically around her. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Design idea: the fitted chest plates divide into concentric self-fracturing shards around the blue core, with matching gaps repeated through the floating shield units
Colours: fallout-ash white, self-glow soft blue, lagoon turquoise, pale coral pink.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a reborn coral atoll turned into a genius-engine city: research domes set around a white lagoon ring, a vast thinking engine glowing soft blue beneath the lagoon, and sampler craft with long filter wings returning from a towering white cloud on the horizon.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: standing balanced with both empty human hands open and fully visible beside her armored hips.
Setting detail: the shield drones hover in a calm symmetric orbit while pale sampler craft descend over the blue-glowing lagoon.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Es) and atomic number (99) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
